verdict.rationale: The evidence never mentions registered agent service or service-of-process handling. It only says Earth Class Mail is now part of LegalZoom and that Virtual Mail works with LegalZoom business formation services, such as Secretary of State status reports. That is an adjacent integration, not documented registered agent service tied to the mailbox account.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get registered agent service tied to the same account — service-of-process handling bundled with or added to my mailbox plan
